ar.tool.description: Subscribe to BACnet COV (Change of Value) notifications for an object. When the value changes, the LLM is automatically notified.
ar.param.lifetime.description: Subscription lifetime in seconds (default: 900). BAC0 auto-renews.
ar.param.label.description: Human-readable label for this subscription (e.g. '3F会議室_室温').
ar.param.on_change_prompt.description: Optional prompt injected into the LLM when a change is detected.
